summary: The checkout page successfully implements the dark theme design system with clean visual hierarchy and correctly functioning components, exhibiting only minor layout asymmetry.

issues.title: Asymmetric alternative payment button
issues.description: The Apple Pay button occupies partial container width without an adjacent option, creating uneven spacing.
issues.evidence: The Apple Pay button terminates near mid-screen under the 'Or pay with' divider.
issues.suggestion: Set the button width to 100% or supply a secondary payment option in a two-column grid.
